declare
 cursor c1 is
 select procedure_code,donation_type,count(*) count
 from donations
 where drive_id = :ctrl_block.drive_id
 and unit_id is not null
 group by procedure_code,donation_type ;
 
 counter number := 0 ;
begin
 if :ctrl_block.drive_id is null then
 go_item( 'ctrl_block.drive_id' );
 show_error( '0080' );
-- show_error( '11082' );
 message ('Drive ID must be selected to retrieve drive information.');

 else

 SELECT count(*) into :GLOBAL.qrycnt
 FROM DRIVE_PROCEDURES
 WHERE drive_id = :drives.drive_id
 and chapter_id = :drives.chapter_id ;
 END;
 BEGIN
 SELECT count(*) into :GLOBAL.qrycnt1
 FROM donations
 WHERE drive_id = :ctrl_block.drive_id
 and unit_id is not null ;

 IF :GLOBAL.qrycnt <= 0 AND :GLOBAL.qrycnt1 <= 0 THEN
 show_error('2331');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 for c1rec in c1 loop
 if counter = 0 then
 go_block('ACTUAL_PROCEDURES') ;
 clear_block(NO_VALIDATE) ;
 first_record ; 
 else
 next_record ;
 end if ;
 :actual_procedures.procedure_code := c1rec.procedure_code ;
 :actual_procedures.donation_type := c1rec.donation_type ;
 :actual_procedures.projected_draw := c1rec.count ;
 counter := counter + 1 ;
 end loop ;
 
 first_record ;
 begin
 select initcap(description) into :actual_procedures.proc_desc
 from valid_proc_codes
 where procedure_code = :actual_procedures.procedure_code;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :actual_procedures.proc_desc := 'No Description';
 end;
 begin
 select initcap(description) into :actual_procedures.don_desc
 from valid_donation_types
 where donation_type = :actual_procedures.donation_type;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :actual_procedures.don_desc := 'No description';
 end ;
 
 go_block('DRIVE_PROCEDURES') ;

 END IF;
:SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL :='0';
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

 WHEN others THEN
 err_flag := 'L';
 return;
 END;
 IF no_pickups > 0 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT no_pickups * to_number(parameter_value)
 INTO courier_cost
 FROM valid_parameters
 WHERE parameter_code = 'CCOST'
 AND v_drive_date between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,v_drive_date+1);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 courier_cost := 0;
 WHEN others THEN
 err_flag := 'M';
 return;
 END;
 END IF;
 --------------------------------------------------------------
 -------------------CALCULATE INCENTIVE COST-------------------
 --------------------------------------------------------------
 BEGIN
 SELECT sum(dci.qty * vim.avg_cost)
 INTO incen_cost
 FROM drive_campaign_items dci, valid_item_master vim
 WHERE dci.drive_id = param_drive_id
 AND dci.item_id = vim.item_code
 AND sysdate between vim.eff_date
 and nvl(vim.term_date,sysdate);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 incen_cost := 0;
 WHEN others THEN
 err_flag := 'N';
 return;
 END;
 ---------------------------------------------------------------
 ------------------CALCULATE VEHICLE COST-----------------------
 ---------------------------------------------------------------
 DECLARE
 no_coach number(4);
 no_van number(4);
 coach_cost number(7,2);
 van_cost number(7,2);
 trav_dist number(6,2);
 BEGIN
 --For Coach--
 BEGIN
 SELECT sum(number_reqd)
 INTO no_coach
 FROM drive_estimated_resources der, valid_parameters vp,
 valid_resources vr
 WHERE der.drive_id = param_drive_id
 AND der.resource_code = vr.resource_code
 AND vr.resource_type = 'COACH'
 AND v_drive_date between vr.eff_date
 and nvl(vr.term_date,v_drive_date+1);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 coach_cost := 0;
 WHEN others THEN
 err_flag := 'O';
 return;
 END;
 BEGIN
 SELECT no_coach * to_number(parameter_value)
 INTO coach_cost
 FROM valid_parameters
 WHERE parameter_code = 'COCOST'
 AND sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 coach_cost := 0;
 END;
 --For Van
 BEGIN
 SELECT sum(number_reqd)
 INTO no_van
 FROM drive_estimated_resources der, valid_parameters vp,
 valid_resources vr
 WHERE der.drive_id = param_drive_id
 AND der.resource_code = vr.resource_code
 AND vr.resource_type = 'VAN'
 AND sysdate between vr.eff_date
 and nvl(vr.term_date,sysdate+1);
 ----Distance-------
 SELECT nvl(travel_distance,0) INTO trav_dist
 FROM locations
 WHERE location_id = param_loc_id;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 van_cost := 0;
 WHEN others THEN
 err_flag := 'P';
 return;
 END;
 BEGIN
 SELECT no_van * to_number(parameter_value) * trav_dist * 2
 INTO van_cost
 FROM valid_parameters
 WHERE parameter_code = 'MCOST'
 AND sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 van_cost := 0;
 END;
 vehicle_cost := van_cost + coach_cost;
 END;
 ---------------Projected Cost----------------------------------
 proj_cost := (nvl(staff_cost,0) + nvl(supply_cost,0)
 + nvl(vehicle_cost,0) + nvl(courier_cost,0)
 + nvl(incen_cost,0))
 / proj_draw;

 exception
 when others then
 err_flag := 'Q' ;
 END calc_proj_cost ;
END DON_TEST ;
